title: Localized affine evaluation on complex representatives
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be affine between schemes [def-pc-scheme], set $A=f_*\mathcal O_X$ [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category], and let $T:\mathrm{Mod}(A)\to\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_Y)$ be scalar restriction. Assume $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ and $D(A)$ exist [def-pc-derived-category]. Suppose an additive functor $H$ is supplied with $i_H:T\circ H\simeq\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_Y}(T(A),-)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom] and an adjunction $T\dashv H$ whose counit evaluates at one through $i_H$. Suppose $R:D(\mathcal O_Y)\to D(A)$ and $\beta:Q_A H^\bullet\to R Q_Y$ are supplied, with $R$ a right derived functor of $H^\bullet$ along quasi-isomorphisms, and $L:D(A)\to D(\mathcal O_Y)$ with $t:L Q_A\simeq Q_Y T^\bullet$ and an adjunction $a:L\dashv R$. Assume for every complex $M$ that $L(\beta_M);\epsilon_{Q_Y M}=t_{H^\bullet M};Q_Y(\epsilon_{0,M}^\bullet)$. For any natural isomorphism $\iota:R\mathcal H om(\mathcal O_Y[0],-)\simeq\mathrm{Id}$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], and every complex $K$ of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], there exists $d:L(R(Q_Y K))\simeq R\mathcal H om(A[0],Q_Y K)$ such that $d;R\mathcal H om(\mathcal O_Y\to A,Q_Y K);\iota_{Q_Y K}=\epsilon_{Q_Y K}$.

proof.text: Use the termwise K-injective evaluation theorem to obtain the canonical unit-Hom natural isomorphism j and the counit-compatible comparison c on K-injective complexes. This involves no supplied derived adjunction.

Choose the existing functorial K-injective resolution K to I. For the K-injective localizer morphism, quasi-isomorphisms between K-injective complexes are homotopy equivalences. Additivity of H preserves these homotopy equivalences, so Q_A H inverts them. The right derivability structure and the supplied right-derived property make beta_I invertible. Compose inverse L(beta_I), t_H(I), and c; the supplied equation h_counit and cancellation of beta_I prove compatibility with the derived counit at QI.

Transport the comparison at QI along the isomorphism q=Q(K to I). Naturality of the derived counit, precomposition map, and j gives the equation at QK. The private Lean lemma transport_evaluation proves this in an arbitrary category.

For the supplied iota, set alpha=iota_QK inverse followed by j_QK. Postcompose the comparison by RHom(A[0],alpha). Naturality of precomposition and of iota gives RHom(O_Y[0],alpha) followed by iota_QK equal to j_QK, proving the required equality. The private Lean lemma change_evaluation_iso proves this in an arbitrary category.
